answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Islamic Beliefs Question ID: 8868 Country: India Title: Aslam-o-alekum, The 1st. November.08 I have a question please answer me at an earliest. My friend says Mohammad(pbuh) got Noor through Jabreel on earth after announcing Resalat, whereas I say that He (pbuh) got Noor from beginning and He (pbuh) is by birth Noori. Please answer with references of Quran and Hadith. Thanking and anticipating the same. Allah Hafiz! Question: Aslam-o-alekum, The 1st. November.08 I have a question please answer me at an earliest. My friend says Mohammad(pbuh) got Noor through Jabreel on earth after announcing Resalat, whereas I say that He (pbuh) got Noor from beginning and He (pbuh) is by birth Noori. Please answer with references of Quran and Hadith. Thanking and anticipating the same. Allah Hafiz! Answer ID: 8868 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1222/1222=M/1429) It is right that the Prophet ( صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم ) got the Quran from Hadhrat Jibeeel which is perfect noor. If you do not believe in the Prophet being a noori creature then it is also right that the Prophet got noor from the beginning. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
